purpose: Convert existing generalized bottleneck/profile evidence into an implementation gate for a retained-gate interface path.

target.prompt_scope: prompt-general calibration/dev; held-out prompts remain reserved

combination_bound_quantum_prompt.interpretation: 70/70 only barely clears 5 tok/s and does not meet the 5.5 pre-source margin. 80/80 is the first symmetric cut with enough overhead margin.

residual_bottleneck_evidence.summary: Gate source/cache time and up/down fallback time are same-order bottlenecks across generalized trace data, so a narrow up/down-only implementation is not enough.

current_graph_blocker.reason: Existing exact graph/dataflow recheck says accepted graph does not expose a retained gate output to build_expert_mix; DS4_HOT recomputes gate and adds payload.

implementation_gate.minimum_bound_to_reopen: A new retained-gate interface proof must show >=80% gate source cut and >=80% up/down fallback cut, or another cut pair with generalized calibration/dev min_eval_tok_s >= 5.5 after estimated overhead.
correctness_requirements: No prompt-specific packs, traces, or admission profiles.
Fixed-text top1/correctness proof before strict cold benchmark.
France prompt must remain semantically correct and coherent.
16GB cgroup must include page cache and must use MemorySwapMax=0.

next_action.description: Design or instrument a retained-gate interface that makes gate/topk/weights available to the expert mix path without recomputing gate or adding large payload, then rerun a hard-bound using measured eligibility/coverage before any token-rate runtime patch.
next_action.success_gate: new hard-bound min_eval_tok_s >= 5.5 on calibration/dev and no held-out prompt usage
next_action.failure_gate: if retained gate cannot cut both source terms near 80/80 under VRAM/RAM constraints, close this path and switch to compact representation feasibility.
